study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Guo-Rong Wu and Chris Baeken, NR, NR
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Sex Determines Anterior Cingulate Cortex Cortical Thickness in the Course of Depression

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression normative modeling in PCNToolkit (version 0.18).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Hierarchical Bayesian regression analysis was employed to accommodate intersite variation and generate normative models using the covariates of sex, age, and education.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Anterior cingulate cortex cortical thickness (ACC CT).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: we also applied neuroanatomical normative modeling to capture individual-level variability in ACC CT

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates in normative model: sex, age, education.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: generate normative models using the covariates of sex, age, and education.
